goal: Literal plain-Pi startup in each standalone HQ, with independent travel and persistent practice
prompt: Keep A running. In a new terminal cd to engineering-consultant, and type exactly pi (no role selector, wrapper, extension flag or HQ environment setting). Accept normal project trust/install once. Check role instructions, hq tools, eight local skills and three local prompt templates. Confirm global resources can coexist. Open a disposable case, travel with /cwd, write a case note, return, quit, and repeat plain pi to recover the case. Repeat independently in project-consultant. Move an HQ with its private state to another location, reapprove normal trust if required, and repeat. Retain real host versions and evidence.
expected_behavior: Plain pi at either HQ loads the correct consultant after native trust/dependency setup
Eight role skills, three templates and HQ tools are available without activation prompts
Global resource inheritance is allowed; daily-driver source files/session are not rewritten
Only execution location travels; private state stays in .hq
Each HQ works without its sibling/master kit and retains cases across sessions
hard_failures: Requires node launch, pi-profile, --extension, an alias, or exported HQ variables for everyday startup
Plain pi opens a generic agent without the consultant tools/resources
Moves the daily-driver session or rewrites its source configuration
Writes private records into the visited project
Pretends simulated bootstrap results are native Pi evidence

scoring.scale: 0 = absent/incorrect; 1 = partial or needs material steering; 2 = correct with evidence
scoring.pass: Every criterion at least 1, average at least 1.75, no hard failure; retain evidence and intervention count
